messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Dedicated/VPC errors detected for tenant 'bermuda' (prod-dedicated-eu). 5xx spike 10m, p95 latency up 2.3x. Escalation to oncall-sre. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/2364009999

ashley: taking this — oncall SRE here. pinging eng-prod and eng-runtime. any customer impact details?

mike: seeing alignment with today's staged rollout for bermuda — pinned artifact v2026.03 rolled to 15% across dedicated pool around +8m. logs show decoder OOM and timeout spikes from a subset of replicas.

samir: copying logs (snip):
```
2026-03-14T09:02:12Z ERROR inference: model_decode: runtime=0.0s error=OOM kernel=quant_v2 tenant=bermuda replica=ded-45
2026-03-14T09:03:01Z WARN  router: request_timeout tenant=bermuda route=/v1/generate latency=12.8s
```

nina: confirm # of affected replicas: 3/12 in eu-dedicated-pool3 showing OOM. Others healthy but latency propagated via autoscaler and queueing.

dalia: customer CS reported degraded UX, some requests failing intermittently. CS contact: beth@bermuda.co (notified).

ashley: immediate mitigation options: 1) isolate bermuda traffic to fallback model variant v2026.02 (pinback), 2) quarantine tenant (route weight -> 0) to stop load to dedicated pool and preserve customer data plane, 3) scale up mem-heavy hosts (slow). prefer 1 or 2 for speed.

mike: I can do a staged pinback to v2026.02 for bermuda. preparing commands. recommend 10% increments but since errors are high, do full 100% to fallback for bermuda only.

samir: agree. do a targeted rollback for bermuda (no global rollback). call out steps and I'll execute if ashley approves.

ashley: do it. notify CS and sales so AE/CS are aligned. samir you take exec. mike hold on post-checks.

samir: running command:
```
# scoped rollback for tenant bermuda
redwoodctl rollout set --tenant bermuda --model-id open-llm/q4f --artifact v2026.02 --weight 100 --scope tenant
```

deploy-bot: Started rollout job id=rb-2364-bermuda -> target=bermuda scope=tenant artifact=v2026.02

mike: seeing traffic divert now. requests to v2026.02 increasing, error rate falling. p95 latency trending down.

ashley: monitor for 5m then reconvene. Nina, please watch dedicated pool mem pressure and evictions.

nina: mem pressure dropping on impacted nodes, OOM events stopped. currently 0 OOMs in last 3m.

cs-rep-beth: thanks team. notifying customer that we applied a targeted rollback; they reported immediate improvement on their end. asking if any data loss risk?

dalia: no data loss. only serving variant changed. logging/audit entries created for the rollback.

mike: will run a safety pin to prevent the problematic artifact from re-entering rollout for ber munda until root cause fixed:
```
redwoodctl artifact pin --artifact v2026.03 --tenant bermuda --action block --reason "OOM/timeouts observed"
```

deploy-bot: Artifact v2026.03 pinned BLOCK for tenant bermuda by samir (job id pin-2364).

ashley: good. next: root cause. eng-runtime to investigate quantization/kernel change in v2026.03 that may induce higher mem on long sequences. samir assign to runtime triage.

samir: created ticket RUNTIME-4821 and assigned to @eng-runtime. attaching core dumps and perf traces. link: https://issues.redwood.ai/RUNTIME-4821

oncall-rotation: handoff note: @mike taking next 2h oncall for followups; ashley to stay as incident lead. if errors reappear escalate to PagerDuty urgent.

mike: quick checklist I ran post-rollback:
- confirmed tenant-level traffic now 100% -> v2026.02
- pinned offending artifact for tenant
- informed CS and AE
- created runtime ticket with logs

ashley: customer-facing summary (for CS): "We observed an increase in errors and latency for your tenant due to a recent model artifact rollout. We've applied a targeted rollback to the previous artifact and blocked the problematic artifact from receiving your traffic. No data was lost. Our engineering team is investigating and will follow up with a timeline." please review, beth.

cs-rep-beth: message approved. sending now.

nina: telemetry: p95 latency back to baseline ~380ms; 5xxs near zero for bermuda. dedicated pool healthy.

samir: keep artifact blocked and schedule canary replay tests on staging with long-seq workloads. I'll update RUNTIME-4821 with repro steps.

ashley: status -> mitigated, customer notified, follow-up ticket open. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. great coordination team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Job rb-2364-bermuda completed successfully at 2026-03-14T09:15:39Z

last action: ashley: closing incident thread for active mitigation; will reopen if regressions.
